केन केन, ind. (inst. fr. 2. क), by what?
wherefore? whence?

केनती केनती, f. an epithet of the wife of
Kāma, the god of love; (a wrong form?).

केनव केनव, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of
Śākapūrṇī.

केनिप केनिप, अस्, m., Ved. a sage, a wise
man; [cf. आकेनिप.]

केनिपात केनिपात or केनिपातक, अस्, m. the
helm, a rudder, a large oar used as a rudder.

केनेषितोपनिषद् केनेषितोपनिषद् or केनो-
पनिषद्, त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad beginning with
the word केनेषितम्.
केन्दु केन्दु, उस्, m. a kind of ebony.

केन्दुक, अस्, m. another variety of ebony yielding
a species of tar, Diospyros Glutinosa.

केन्द्र केन्द्र, अम्, n. (a word borrowed from
the Gr. κέντρον), the centre of a circle; the equation
of the centre; the argument of a circle; the argu-
ment of an equation; the distance of a planet from
the first point of its orbit in the fourth, seventh, or
tenth degree; it is variously applied in composition,
as पतन-केन्द्रम्, argument of the latitude;
द्वितीय-केन्द्रम्, the distance of the higher apsis of
a planet in any point of its orbit; शीघ्र-केन्द्रम्,
[]
commutation, the distance of the sun from a superior
planet or of an inferior planet from the sun; मन्द-
केन्द्रम्, argument of anomaly.
